messages:
emily: Noticed a weird visual when changing time window presets while scrubbing: p95 anchor jumps and the heatmap bars reflow for a frame. Repro: 6h range, Sampling=On, switch preset while dragging. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.ai/snap/preset-jump.png

ryan: Yep I can repro. It looks like we recompute bucket widths synchronously on preset change which triggers reflow.

nina: UX idea: can we keep the pill anchored to the scrubber using a separate overlay layer so bucket width recalcs don't affect the pill position? That would keep the context and avoid the jump.

omar: Technical: doable. Render pill in an absolutely positioned overlay and update its transform on pointermove. That prevents layout thrash. We'll need to ensure transforms are GPU accelerated (translate3d).

a11y-bot: Accessibility reminder: if the pill is moved via transform, keyboard focus must follow. Add tabindex=0 and aria-live="polite" updates for p95 value. Also announce when presets change ("Range preset: last 6 hours").

emily: Microcopy: current preset label '6h' is terse. Suggest 'Last 6 hours' for clarity and for SR context. Also the density menu should be labeled 'Bucket resolution' not just 'Resolution'.

ryan: I like overlay + copy changes. One perf caveat: when switching presets we still re-render buckets; overlay must remain mounted and animate opacity on incoming buckets. Don't unmount during transition.

omar: I'll implement overlay + opacity fade for bucket layers, keep bucket virtualization stable. Also add a small debounce (50ms) for preset-triggered recalcs so we don't thrash if users toggle quickly.

nina: For keyboard: when pressing left/right to step the scrubber, announce step size and new p95. e.g., "Step: 1 minute. p95: 180ms."

a11y-bot: Recommend prefixing live updates with "Chart percentiles:" so screen reader users get context. Example: aria-live text = "Chart percentiles: p95 180 milliseconds". Use words not abbreviations for units where possible.

emily: Can you also make the preset dropdown return focus to the opener on close? Esc currently drops focus.

ryan: Will do. Follow WAI-ARIA menu pattern.

omar: Pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/9901  overlay, opacity fade, debounce, aria-live. Preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/heatmap/preview/2170000000

nina: Tested on staging (Chrome + macVO). Jump gone, pill remains tied to thumb, VoiceOver reads p95 during scrubs and announces preset changes. One small visual: opacity transition on buckets is a tad slow at 200ms; suggest 120ms.

omar: Adjusted to 120ms. Also updated preset labels to full text.

a11y-bot: All a11y checks: live region present and announcements clear, focus flows fixed, tabindex added. Passing automated smoke.

emily: Let's include a short changelog: "Heatmap: stabilize p95 anchor during presets & scrubbing; clarify preset labels; improve keyboard/screen-reader announcements." Planning to ship as a minor console patch. Thanks team :rocket:
